g.text: Night sample · genera with ≥10 recorded genus-nights
Source: Baird et al. (2021), Coral Spawning Database v1. Exact natural-reef starts only; one median per genus/subsite/date.
Dots are recorded units; distributions show spread, not uncertainty about a biological effect. Midnight ambiguity is excluded.
Individual records reveal more than a median and a horizontal interval.
Spawning time varies within the night—and some corals spawn by day
